run_GTestXMLOutputUnitTest: run the gtest XML output unit test to verify Google Test XML report generation
test_nonEmptyXmlOutput: test that a gtest binary produces the expected non-empty XML output with test results
test_emptyXmlOutput: test that a gtest binary without tests produces an empty XML output document
test_timestampValue: test that the timestamp attribute in gtest XML output is a valid ISO datetime
test_defaultOutputFile: test that gtest produces an XML file named test_detail.xml by default
